segments.comment: shk.c u_entered_shop() compares eshkp->customer with plname by strncmpi(..., PL_NSIZ), copies plname into customer with strncpy(..., PL_NSIZ), and greets the hero by plname. The nethackrc name is 31 UTF-8 bytes (PL_NSIZ - 1, the longest name C keeps) in 19 characters, with three-byte letters and combining marks, so the greeting wraps where its bytes reach the line end. Debug mode would rename the hero "wizard", so this explore-mode Valkyrie walks: seeds 9010001-9010010 were replayed with the port, walking each to the down stairs by a shortest path over the generated map, and this seed's level 2 has a general store whose door the hero then walks through. Seed range, clock and name were chosen before the walk.
